defects: Quantity shortfall: 52 EACH received against 60 EACH invoiced (8 kits refused at dock as damaged)
rationale: Receipt GR-7724 records only 52 of 60 kits accepted; 8 were refused damaged. Under clause 4 the shortfall is resolved in favour of the receipt and paid on received quantity: 52 x $320.00 = $16,640.00 net, plus recomputed 7.5% tax of $1,248.00 (clause 5) = $17,888.00. Supplier's tax rate was correct, so the only defect is the quantity shortfall — a single defect, no clause 11 escalation. Net payable falls in the AP_MANAGER band (clause 10).
